title: Eubie Blake, Sissle, Miller and Lyles, and watching Eubie conduct
summary: Whaley recalls Shuffle Along, Brown Skin Models, Miller and Lyles and Sissle and Blake, and Eubie's ritual at the piano.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Go on and tell me about Eubie Blake, 1918.

Eubie I met, I met him some show and we did -- oh, he was in Shuffle Along and 63rd Street and they went down to Baltimore somewhere and got stranded and they didn't do so good and come on back and then he came up to -- he come in the theatre. Irving Miller, Brown Skin Models.
Producer, yeah, he had Brown Skin Models. So I don't know how he got with Eubie, but I know with Sissle --
It was Miller and Lyles, now who was Lyles.
Aubrey Lyles. He was a comedian with Miller, Flournay Miller. Miller and Lyles, Sissle and Blake, see, and they used to do a skit, see, together, but Eubie was

a musical, you know, he was a director of music. I know where I met Eubie. I keep on talking, I met him up in Boston and he had the band and I used to admire him and he'd come out from under that -- come out of the hole --

Yeah, the pit and come up there and take his watch out and look at the time and then he'd sit down and put his hands over the -- he'd stretch his fingers and then he'd start playing. I used to say that's wonderful. And we became great friends through the year. I arranged for him. He's got a number down in this show, Eubie, that I arranged. Two or three of them in this show. Get it. Have you seen the show.
